description: This file contains unit tests for the DataElement and LinkedDataElement classes and their functionalities, using Google Test framework. It tests copying, size handling, CRC calculation, search, setting and getting numbers, bit manipulation, and linked list behaviors.

classes.name: DataElement
classes.description: Class representing a data element with methods for copying, CRC, searching, setting/getting values, and size management.

classes.name: LinkedDataElement
classes.description: Class representing a linked data element that can enclose other elements and manage linked buffers.

classes.name: DataElementParser
classes.description: Class used to parse DataElement objects with methods to validate, skip bytes, and get size.

methods.name: Copy
methods.description: Copies data from source to destination, supports different overloads.

methods.name: Size
methods.description: Gets or sets the size of the DataElement or its buffer.

methods.name: SearchNumber
methods.description: Searches for a number within the DataElement with specified endianness.

methods.name: SetNumber
methods.description: Sets a number at a specified position with specified endianness.

methods.name: GetNumber
methods.description: Retrieves a number at a specified position with specified endianness.

methods.name: Search
methods.description: Searches for a sequence within the data.

methods.name: Set
methods.description: Sets a value at a specific offset.

methods.name: Align
methods.description: Aligns data to a type boundary.

methods.name: Enclosed
methods.description: Sets the linked element as enclosed within another.

methods.name: SetBuffer
methods.description: Sets a buffer within the linked data element.
